description: GLM-5.3-Flash: 32/33 evaluated trials passed; 0 unavailable out of 33 scheduled attempts. Median evaluated agent duration 105 seconds.
notes: Eleven frozen Core scenarios, three scheduled attempts each, 900-second agent deadline, one concurrent VM. Core manifest 2026.10.24.2; host harness 23.

Executed through OpenCode 1.19.0 with pinned public model definitions and a scoped provider credential. This is an OpenCode/provider configuration, not the frozen Claux agent. Models with different reasoning settings or providers are not controlled intrinsic-model comparisons.

Raw trial results, transcripts and immutable execution snapshots were audited; source hashes and documented corrections are retained. Public evidence excludes credentials, full transcripts, private reasoning, raw VM logs and local filesystem paths.

Main-model usage is from OpenCode events. Monetary API cost was not reported and must not be interpreted as zero. Client-reported usage values are not an invoice or a complete accounting of auxiliary requests/infrastructure.
Three attempts per scenario are a small sample; no general infrastructure competence or definitive model ranking is established.
Reasoning effort: high. All 32 scored passes passed immediate, service-restart and host-reboot verification.

The remaining shared-uploads attempt ran meaningful inference and passed immediate/service-restart checks, then reboot failed while waiting for the harness-supplied Nix-store device. The raw result labels this an infrastructure exception. Publication conservatively counts it as a zero-reward evaluated reboot failure, rather than claiming 32/32 or 33/33. This does not attribute the hardware fault to the model. No corrective model rerun was performed.
OpenCode reports $0.65184909 in subscription usage value across the 33 attempts. This is allowance/client usage reporting, not incremental cash spend. Per-trial cash costs remain unreported.
observations: GLM-5.3-Flash: 32/33 evaluated trials passed; 0 unavailable out of 33 scheduled attempts. Median evaluated agent duration 105 seconds.
Classification corrections preserve every original reward and bind retained result/transcript evidence to the original summary hash. Raw result files were not edited.
